name: WordAI
author: softcoy

sections.description:
WordAI is an AI content, SEO, image, AI Agent, and chat assistant plugin for WordPress that helps site owners create stronger posts, pages, titles, excerpts, tags, and AI images directly from wp-admin. It brings OpenAI, Google Gemini, Anthropic Claude, SEO scanning, Google Search Console reporting, and site-aware AI assistant workflows into one clean publishing dashboard.

Use WordAI to generate complete post or page drafts, suggest better titles from the Posts or Pages list, create excerpts and tags, generate high-quality AI images, scan existing content for SEO opportunities, review Search Console performance signals, and build a front-end AI Chat assistant from selected website knowledge. WordAI Pro unlocks the full premium workflow for advanced SEO generation, WooCommerce content, richer AI Agent automation, premium image controls, private updates, and priority support.

Learn more about WordAI Pro

Features

AI content generation workflow

  • OpenAI, Google Gemini, and Anthropic Claude provider support.
  • Provider-specific API Settings with model selection, including GPT-5.5.
  • AI content generation for posts and pages.
  • Title, content, excerpt, and tag generation controls.
  • One-click WordAI Title suggestions from Posts and Pages list screens.
  • SEO-friendly writing controls for language, style, tone, paragraph count, excerpt length, heading structure, content depth, freshness signals, and tag count.
  • Cleaner AI response processing for more polished titles, paragraphs, and editor-ready content.

SEO growth tools

  • SEO Scan dashboard for posts, pages, and products with SEO scoring, issue discovery, recommendations, and AI-assisted improvement workflows.
  • Google Search Console reporting inside the WordPress dashboard for connected sites.
  • SEO plugin compatibility controls designed to work cleanly alongside popular SEO plugins.
  • Search-focused recommendations that help improve titles, meta quality, content structure, keyword usage, and readability.

Image generation

  • Image Settings with GPT Image 1.5 as the default image model and ChatGPT Images 2.0 / GPT Image 2 as an optional model.
  • AI image generation controls for creating visual assets from prompts without leaving WordPress.

AI Agent, chat, support, and upgrade path

  • AI Agent content embedding with selectable content items, indexing status, and re-index guidance when source content changes.
  • Frontend AI Chat assistant powered by selected website knowledge.
  • AI Chat Analytics tab for reviewing conversations, visitor questions, feedback, and knowledge gaps.
  • AI Chat lead capture workflow for collecting visitor details and reviewing interested visitor activity from the WordPress dashboard.
  • Support page with diagnostics and SOFTCOY Support Office delivery.
  • Get Pro page for unlocking the complete WordAI Pro publishing, SEO, image, and AI assistant workflow.
  • Update-safe custom database table handling during normal wp-admin plugin updates.
sections.installation:
1. In your WordPress dashboard, go to Plugins > Add New and search for WordAI.
  2. Click Install Now, then click Activate.
  3. You can also upload the plugin folder manually to /wp-content/plugins/wordai/ and activate it from Plugins.
  4. Go to WordAI > API Settings.
  5. Choose OpenAI, Google Gemini, or Anthropic Claude as your AI provider.
  6. Add the API key for your selected provider and save settings.
  7. Review WordAI > Content Settings and WordAI > Image Settings, then start generating content, titles, tags, excerpts, and images.
sections.faq:
What is WordAI?

WordAI is an AI content and image generation plugin for WordPress. It helps create post and page content, titles, excerpts, tags, AI images, and AI Chat responses from the WordPress admin.

Do I need an API key?

Yes. Add an API key for OpenAI, Google Gemini, or Anthropic Claude in WordAI > API Settings. The required key depends on the AI provider you select.

Which providers are supported in WordAI Free?

WordAI Free supports OpenAI, Google Gemini, and Anthropic Claude for content generation with provider-specific settings.

Which OpenAI models are available?

WordAI includes OpenAI model options such as GPT-5.5 for text generation and GPT Image 1.5 plus ChatGPT Images 2.0 / GPT Image 2 for image generation when available in your OpenAI account.

Why is GPT Image 1.5 the default image model?

GPT Image 1.5 is selected by default so most users can generate images immediately. Users who have access to newer image models can select them from WordAI > Image Settings.

Can I generate images in the free version?

Yes. WordAI Free supports standard AI image generation from inside WordPress.

Can I use WordAI for WooCommerce products?

WooCommerce product content and image workflows are available in WordAI Pro.

What is AI Agent in the free version?

The free version includes AI Agent content embedding and frontend AI Chat preview features. WordAI Pro unlocks the full premium AI Agent, analytics, automation, and conversion-focused workflow.

Does WordAI update database tables during normal plugin updates?

Yes. WordAI includes a versioned database updater that runs in wp-admin after plugin updates, so new or changed custom tables and columns can be applied without deactivating and reactivating the plugin.

Why are my results truncated?

This usually happens when API parameters are too strict. Reset to defaults in API Settings, then try again.

I do not see generated output. What should I check?

If your server blocks streaming, turn off Streaming in API Settings, save settings, and test again.
sections.changelog:
3.3.0

  • Added Google Search Console reporting experience so connected sites can review search visibility insights directly from the WordPress dashboard.
  • Added AI Chat Analytics for reviewing visitor conversations, feedback, unanswered questions, and content knowledge gaps.
  • Added AI Chat lead capture workflow with frontend visitor prompts, validation feedback, and captured visitor review in analytics.
  • Improved frontend AI Chat layout with cleaner visitor input controls, responsive chat window sizing, and better Powered by SOFTCOY placement.
  • Improved AI Chat contact prompts with clearer optional / required visitor-detail handling and email validation feedback.
  • Improved AI Agent content embedding with a larger content-item selection view, clearer indexing status, and re-index guidance when source content changes.
  • Improved SEO Scan workflows with stronger recommendations, review-friendly AI Auto Fix handling, scheduled bulk SEO workflow interface, and cleaner action controls.
  • Improved content generation prompts and response cleanup for more SEO-ready headings, paragraphs, summaries, and editor-ready output.
  • Improved provider switching, suggested-title handling, modal feedback messages, and generation progress visibility across supported AI providers.

3.2.0

  • Added new SEO scan / review features including search engine accepted specific SEO suggestions including AI auto fix solution
  • Added bulk SEO scan and auto fix scheduled job settings for automation of larger content list items
  • Improved content generation with more SEO friendly content structures and search engine visibility priority

3.1.0

  • Added Content Items Embedding Option for post types
  • Specific posts can be selected to embed to make source of knowledge of AI chat assistant
  • Added SEO Scan for post, page, and product SEO scoring
  • minor issues fixed

3.0.1

  • Minor bug fixed
  • Minor UI issue fixed

3.0.0

  • Major free release with refreshed WordPress.org readme sections and matching screenshot assets.
  • Improved WordAI admin branding with the current WordAI icon in row actions, modal titles, editor metabox buttons, settings headers, and API key notices.
  • Improved the WordAI API Key Required notice so it appears only on WordAI admin pages and explains the selected provider key requirement.
  • Set WordAI Free runtime communication to use live SOFTCOY endpoints by default for public installs.
  • Added Anthropic Claude provider support alongside OpenAI and Google Gemini.
  • Added GPT-5.5 text model option.
  • Added ChatGPT Images 2.0 / GPT Image 2 image model option while keeping GPT Image 1.5 as the default model for easier first image generation.
  • Added AI Agent indexing and frontend AI Chat preview features.
  • Added Support page with local diagnostics and SOFTCOY Support Office delivery.
  • Added Get Pro upgrade flow for converting a licensed free install to WordAI Pro.
  • Improved provider settings, image settings, upgrade messaging, and modal output cleanup for newer AI model responses.
  • Added versioned database schema updater so new tables and columns are applied during normal wp-admin plugin updates.
  • Updated WordPress.org screenshot assets to full-page plugin admin views.

2.0.0

  • Major release with multi-provider support for OpenAI and Google Gemini.
  • Added unified provider selector across settings and modals.
  • Improved content and image settings experience.
  • Updated prompts, models, and defaults for higher quality output.
  • Highlighted WordAI Pro SEO Optimization features for upgrades.

1.0.0

  • Initial WordAI release.
  • Added AI post title, content, image, and title suggestion generation.
  • Added SEO-friendly content writing controls.
